subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should Claws use shared global plugin installs with advisory provenance references and warning-only uninstall behavior?
rationale: That choice defines permanent ownership, removal, update, and recovery behavior across the experimental Claws lifecycle and cannot be resolved from implementation mechanics alone.

options.title: Approve advisory shared references
options.body: Keep shared installs and warning-only removal after the consent-ordering and canonical-persistence defects are repaired.

options.title: Require lifecycle ownership
options.body: Add locking or reference-count enforcement before packages referenced by a Claw can be removed.

options.title: Defer package mutation
options.body: Keep package actions read-only until the broader lifecycle ownership contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve advisory shared references
recommendation.body: Keep shared installs and warning-only removal after the consent-ordering and canonical-persistence defects are repaired.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this owner to the state schema and both installer trust surfaces that define the decision.
